primary_target: 12-month USD total return minus decision-eligible equal-weight mean
training_start: first month with >=20 common eligible markets, selected from input coverage only
common_eligibility: stage12 scored_eligible and observed GDP level/revision z, CPI level/revision z, and all three market controls z
refit: at first valid forecast month, then every 12 months; expanding training history
ridge_objective: weighted mean squared error + 1.0 * sum(squared slopes); intercept unpenalized
normalization: freeze weighted training means/std at each refit; impute missing standardized values to zero and provide identical primitive missingness masks to all macro arms
training_weights: each date equal weight, each macro identity equal total weight within date, divided among its market tokens
concept_construction: equal-weight oriented mean of fit-standardized component values, including neutral training-mean fills with explicit primitive masks; rescale columns by training standard deviation before ridge
interaction_controls: identical terms supplied to state and primitive interaction arms; no assumed return coefficient signs
portfolios: top ceil(0.2*N) equal weight, monthly refresh and 12-month self-financing staggered sleeves; common dates and eligibility for model comparisons
source_status: frozen stage12 conditional vendor-history snapshot; monthly index-return proxy, not executable fills
decisions: Report all arms. Useful macro indication means macro arm improves gross annualized return over common EW, fixed V+M and learned market-only on primary 12-month sleeve expression; weaker expressions and concentration remain visible. Failure is scoped to this fixed first design, not every possible MacroState architecture.
deferred: country-specific slopes, neural/tree models, new interactions, 3/6-month fitting, and parameter sweeps
